decisions.reason: As a core resin-processing unit with likely modest carrying cost, it is still worth retaining, although after several years the firm may prune overlap if demand has concentrated on alternatives.

This unit remains close to the firm's technical base and service network, but its similarity to other resin injection offerings makes rationalization somewhat more plausible now that market learning should be clearer.
The automatic airless spray gun fits tightly into the established spray-application portfolio, so keeping it open remains low-cost and strategically consistent.
A multi-model line in a central application area offers broad coverage across customer needs and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn absent clear failure.
The data logger is the most peripheral and support-intensive option, but it still complements the installed equipment base and preserves learning value in digital monitoring.
